Security Composer: the new document look (B134)

Datasec · Monday, 12 Oct 2026 · synthetic data only

BLUF. When a policy has a named target, the worksheet and the change report now take their title from it, in the approved form "<target> for <customer>", in place of the HPSM policy name. And when a policy has more than 12 areas, the policy summary's Main decisions table folds to one row per top-level area, so the summary stays on page 2 and no longer spills onto page 3. QA gate B136 passed it GO WITH NOTES. It is merged to main (PR #73, B134 commit ed0f531e; main is now eddb484b) but not yet on the demo. The demo still runs 7910674f. Your call: a) approve and deploy, b) deploy with a change you name, or c) hold.

No named target: nothing changes. Every output without a named target is byte-identical to today's (B136 checked 104 of 104 files by sha256). Today's 11-area policy PDF and DOCX are byte-identical too.

(a) Titles with a named target

Fictional example: target "Essential Eight — Maturity Level Two" for customer "Northwind Test Freight Pty Ltd". BEFORE = 7910674f (today's demo); AFTER = ed0f531e (B134, merged).

BEFORE · worksheet title row

"Datasec Policy Designer implementation worksheet | Synthetic engagement on real provisional content | manifest …"

AFTER · worksheet title row

"Datasec Policy Designer implementation worksheet | Essential Eight — Maturity Level Two for Northwind Test Freight Pty Ltd | manifest …". The XLSX document title becomes "… for Northwind Test Freight Pty Ltd: implementation worksheet".

BEFORE · change report, page 1 title and footer
AFTER · change report, page 1 title and footer

Footer, BEFORE: "Datasec Policy Designer | Synthetic engagement on real provisional content: change report". AFTER: "Datasec Policy Designer | Essential Eight — Maturity Level Two for Northwind Test Freight Pty Ltd: change report". The manifest line under it is the same in both.

The subtitle "Datasec Policy Designer: change report" stays the same. The page footer and the DOCX title use the new title too. File names do not change (still held).

(b) Policy summary: Main decisions table with more than 12 areas

Synthetic 24-area policy (12 top-level areas). BEFORE = 7910674f; AFTER = ed0f531e. Pages 2 and 3 of the policy PDF.

BEFORE · page 2

24 rows, one per "Area > Group". The page is full.

BEFORE · page 3

The summary runs onto page 3 ("8 more groups…" and all of "What you need to do").

AFTER · page 2

12 rows, one per top-level area, with counts summed, plus "All areas". The whole summary fits on page 2.

AFTER · page 3

Page 3 now opens with Scope, as it should.

The same happens at 16 areas (8 top-level rows). With 12 areas or fewer (today's content has 11) the table is unchanged. One thing to look at: the sentence above the table still says "in 24 areas" while the folded table shows 12 rows. Both are true. No note was added, because a note would be new wording, and new wording is your call.

The Minor: a very long title loses the footer's manifest line

If the target name is about 80 characters or more and the customer name is about 200 characters, the change report's footer wraps to 3 lines, and the "manifest <hash>" line is no longer printed. Nothing else in the document breaks. The policy PDF has had the same problem since B103. QA logged it as a Minor to fix later (B136-F1, footer line budget). It does not block. Shown at ed0f531e:

80-character target, 200-character customer: no manifest line
36-character target, 200-character customer: manifest line present

Which commit each image shows

  • BEFORE images: renderers source at 7910674f, the current main before the merge and the build on the demo today.
  • AFTER images and the Minor's footer images: ed0f531e, the B134 head. It was merged as PR #73 (de95b413), and main is now eddb484b (#73 plus B135's #74). B136 confirmed that merging B134 on its own gives the same tree as its head. B135 changes no look.
